skill_name: Construct a proposal regarding a school initiative to recycle during lunchtime
workflow: This proposal outlines a new school initiative to adopt a recycling program during lunchtime. The goal of this program is to reduce the amount of waste generated during lunchtime by providing recycling bins in each of the school's lunchrooms. The bins will be clearly marked and each student should be encouraged to place recyclable items such as paper, plastic, cans, and bottles in the respective bins.
